about_the_game:
The Last Market is an open-world game set in a post-apocalyptic world, where you run your own market in a safe zone for survivors. You can sell items you collect from zombies or from buildings and campsites in the open world in your market. The income you earn from this market allows you to expand and customize your current market. With future features, you'll need even more money to defend your safe zone from zombie attacks and upgrade your character's abilities.

Current Features:

  • An open world survival game where you try to survive and build and operate your market as you wish.

  • A post-apocalyptic open world to explore.

  • Fight zombies in an open world.

  • Vehicles that you can use both as storage and to roam around the open world.

  • A variety of firearms and melee weapons are available for you to use.

  • Build your own market to meet the needs of those living in the safe area.

  • Earn money by selling the items you collect from the open world to those living in the safe area in your own market.

  • Improve your market with the money you earn and buy what you need from other vendors in the safe area.

  • Day/Night cycles.

Planned Features:

  • CO-OP system where you can play with your friends up to 4 players.

  • Zombie hordes will attack the safe zone at regular intervals and a defense system will be added to prevent these attacks.

  • Character stats system.

  • Armed AI characters and military zones that we can fight with.

  • Small quests you can receive from those living in the safe zone.

  • Weather system. Snow and Rain.

  • Damage system for vehicles.

  • Clothing system that also has a protective effect for the character.

  • New buildables and more customization options for your market.

  • New weapons, new vehicles, and new sellable items.

  • Map improvements and new areas.

  • Weapon and vehicle customizations.

  • And much more. Stay tuned.

content_descriptors.notes: May contain content that is not appropriate for all ages. Some violence, blood and general mature content is present in the game.
